description: Ticket W1A-1. Add src/main/process-bridge/capabilities.ts and agtop-adapter.ts: capability discovery by facts, schema validation of each agtop return value, and the degradation table (no method throws because agtop or one function is absent, except spawnContained, which rejects).

contracts.text: export interface LemonadeStatus { reachable: boolean; url: string; loadedModels: string[]; availableModels: string[]; error?: string }
export async function killAgentTree(id: string, options: { expectedStartTime?: string } = {}): Promise<KillResult> {
export function getAcceleratorSnapshot(): AcceleratorSnapshot | undefined { return latestSnapshot; }

steps: Read the contracts in this ticket, then global-sct/src/shared/boundary-schemas.ts, global-sct/src/main/share-gate.ts (code style), and global-sct/tests/workspace-link.test.ts (how a test imports the real agtop).

Create capabilities.ts with probeAgtopCapabilities. For each pair it checks `typeof module[name] === 'function'`: agtop.trees listAgentTrees, agtop.kill killAgentTree, agtop.spawn-contained spawnContainedAgent, agtop.roles roleCatalog, agtop.accelerators getAcceleratorSnapshot, agtop.lemonade-probe probeLemonade, agtop.worktree-detect resolveGitWorktree, agtop.daemon startDaemon. For agtop.roles it also calls roleCatalog() and requires decodeBody('role-catalog', ...) to be ok. A missing capability goes in `missing` with a reason string. A module that is not an object gives all 8 missing.

Create agtop-adapter.ts. createAgtopAdapter awaits load() inside try/catch; a failed import gives an adapter with all agtop capabilities missing and the import error as the reason. Export interface AgtopAdapter { capabilities(): CapabilitySet; listTrees(): Promise<ProcessListing>; killTree(treeId: string, expectedStartTime?: string): Promise<KillResult>; spawnContained(options: SpawnAgentOptions): Promise<SpawnedAgent>; roleCatalog(): RoleInfo[]; acceleratorSnapshot(): AcceleratorSnapshot | null; probeLemonade(baseUrl?: string): Promise<LemonadeStatus | null> }.

listTrees: without agtop.trees return { supported: false, reason }. Else call listAgentTrees(), build { supported: true, trees, accelerators: acceleratorSnapshot(), listedAt: Date.now() }, set tree.harnessId only when tree.harness is in HARNESS_IDS, and validate with decodeBody('process-listing', ...). A thrown error or a failed validation gives { supported: false, reason } with the message; it never throws.

killTree: without agtop.kill return { killedPids: [], failedPids: [], errors: [reason] }. Else call killAgentTree(treeId, { expectedStartTime }) (omit the key when undefined) and validate with decodeBody('kill-result', ...). A thrown error gives the same failure shape with the error message. Never call process.kill.

spawnContained: without agtop.spawn-contained reject with an Error whose `code` property is 'containment-unavailable'. Else call spawnContainedAgent(options) and return only { jobId, pid, containmentMode }.

roleCatalog: without agtop.roles return []. Else return the validated catalog. acceleratorSnapshot: without agtop.accelerators, or when getAcceleratorSnapshot() returns undefined, or when validation fails, return null. probeLemonade: without agtop.lemonade-probe return null (Wave 1D has the local fallback). Else return the validated status.
Create tests/agtop-adapter.test.ts with one test for each line in tests.must_add. The tests with the real agtop use the default load. The stub tests pass a load function.
Run `bun run typecheck:tsc` and `bun run lint` from global-sct/ and correct each error. Commit the three files with one commit.
acceptance_criteria: Only files in src/main/process-bridge/ import 'agtop' at run time (a type-only import in another file is permitted)
Each agtop return value passes through decodeBody before the adapter returns it
No adapter method except spawnContained throws or rejects when agtop or a function is absent
No call to process.kill and no process-role classification exists in the two files
No `any` and no type cast to a contract type without validation
bun run typecheck:tsc, bun run lint, and bun run test pass

must_add: With the real agtop, capabilities() lists all 8 agtop capabilities as present and none as missing
With the real agtop, roleCatalog() returns a non-empty list in which each entry has role, label, description, and definitions
With the real agtop on Linux, listTrees() returns supported true with an array of trees and a listedAt number

With a stub module that lacks killAgentTree and getAcceleratorSnapshot, capabilities() lists those two as missing with a reason, killTree returns a result with one error and no killed pid, and acceleratorSnapshot returns null
With a load function that rejects, each capability is missing, listTrees returns supported false with the reason, roleCatalog returns [], and probeLemonade returns null
spawnContained rejects with code containment-unavailable when spawnContainedAgent is absent
A stub listAgentTrees that returns a tree with an unknown harness and an extra field gives supported true, harnessId undefined, and no extra field in the result
A stub listAgentTrees that returns a value of the wrong shape gives supported false and does not throw
A stub killAgentTree that throws gives a KillResult with the error message in errors
A stub roleCatalog that returns an invalid entry makes agtop.roles missing and roleCatalog() return []

findings: Ready for dispatch through a T3 subagent (decision S4).
